program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define seeds
      (filter (lambda (cell) (and (not (= (third cell) 0)) (not (= (third cell) 5)))) (grid-cells g)))
    (define dist (make-hash))
    (define owners (make-hash))
    (define queue (list))
    (for ([cell (in-list seeds)])
      (define p (list (first cell) (second cell)))
      (hash-set! dist p 0)
      (hash-set! owners p (list (third cell)))
      (set! queue (append queue (list p))))
    (define (uniq xs) (remove-duplicates xs))
    (define (search)
      (unless (empty? queue)
        (define cur (first queue))
        (set! queue (rest queue))
        (define curd (hash-ref dist cur))
        (define curo (hash-ref owners cur))
        (for ([d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
          (define nr (+ (first cur) (first d)))
          (define nc (+ (second cur) (second d)))
          (define p (list nr nc))
          (when (and (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g)) (not (= (at g nr nc) 5)))
            (define nd (+ curd 1))
            (cond [(not (hash-has-key? dist p))
                   (hash-set! dist p nd)
                   (hash-set! owners p curo)
                   (set! queue (append queue (list p)))]
                  [(= nd (hash-ref dist p))
                   (hash-set! owners p (uniq (append (hash-ref owners p) curo)))])))
        (search)))
    (search)
    (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
      (lambda (r c)
        (let ((v (at g r c)) (p (list r c)))
          (cond [(= v 5) v]
                [(not (= v 0)) v]
                [(not (hash-has-key? dist p)) 0]
                [else
                 (let ((os (hash-ref owners p)))
                   (if (= (length os) 1) (first os) 0))]))))))
